goal: Stop nodes from accepting and dialing multicast addresses received from peer gossip
Avoids wasting outbound connection slots on unreachable multicast endpoints
agreement: Verified by testing multicast address rejection on regtest (atsushi196323)
Questions whether excluding multicast addresses solves a practical problem (0xB10C)
Asks if existing addrman entries should also be blocked from outbound dialing (ValeraFinebits)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because wasting connection slots on gossiped multicast addresses is an uncommon edge case
The reliability gain is modest since peers can still advertise other unreachable address ranges
